title: Cloudflare Status - Cloudflare Workers API
text:
Service: Cloudflare Status
Incident: Cloudflare Workers API
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-10-12T13:32:12.316Z
Resolved: 2026-10-12T14:05:20.580Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-12T14:05:20.580Z: resolved - This incident has been resolved.
- 2026-10-12T13:42:46.776Z: monitoring - A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
- 2026-10-12T13:32:12.316Z: investigating - Cloudflare is investigating 504s errors when interacting with Workers API and Workers configuration in the dashboard. Customers might experience some unavailability on Workers endpoints, particularly when deploying a script. 

Workers that are already running in production are not affected. More updates to follow shortly.

incident_updates.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.

Cloudflare is investigating 504s errors when interacting with Workers API and Workers configuration in the dashboard. Customers might experience some unavailability on Workers endpoints, particularly when deploying a script. 

Workers that are already running in production are not affected. More updates to follow shortly.

components.name: Workers
components.description: Cloudflare Workers provides a serverless execution environment that allows you to create new applications or augment existing ones without configuring or maintaining infrastructure
